text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Time came back.** Reps cut post-call admin from about 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling time, not just tidier CRM records.

**2. Better notes changed coaching.** Managers could finally review real conversations instead of rep summaries. Coaching got more specific, fast.

**3. Consent matters.** Some customers hesitated. Reps who asked upfront and explained the "why" saw almost no pushback.

**4. Accuracy isn't perfect.** Product names and jargon tripped it up. A quick 2-minute review became part of the routine.

**5. Adoption followed trust.** Reps embraced it once they saw it wasn't surveillance.

Our takeaway: treat AI notes as a teammate to onboard, not a tool to deploy.

What's your team seeing?
